ghs.en: And then I was awake.

rows.en: I check deep inside the thicket.

ghs.en: I ascertain the depths of the thicket.

rows.jp: とうとう、ここを使うのも最後の一回だ。
rows.en: At last, I’ll only need this place one more time.

ghs.en: Finally, this will be the last time I use this.
What remains now... is one person.
Hasekura Youko---

rows.jp: 今までより慎重やらないといけない。
rows.en: I have to proceed more cautiously than ever.

ghs.en: It is imperative I be much more prudent than I've been up to now.

rows.jp: 決して失敗はできない。

ghs.en: I absolutely cannot fail.

rows.jp: ……彼女に抱いている叛意を、気取られてはならない。
rows.en: ...She must never detect my intent to turn against her.

ghs.en: ...I must not make her suspect of that spirit of rebellion I harbor against her.

rows.jp: そして今までと違う唯一の点。
rows.en: And the one thing different from every time before.

ghs.en: And then, there is one and only point of difference with what has been up to now:
Taichi: "Memories... I don't want."

rows.en: There is no lunch waiting for me.

ghs.en: No lunch has been laid.
The pattern is wrong.
Taichi: "..."
This makes me anxious.

rows.jp: 皆がいなくなると同時に……行動様式が変わる。

ghs.en: Behavioral pattern changes... simultaneous with the disappearance of all.
Taichi: "...what's with that."
I click my tongue.

rows.jp: 気取られないようにしてきたつもりなのに。
rows.en: I thought I had concealed it from her.

ghs.en: When I had intended not to make her suspect!

rows.jp: 彼女は恋に盲目だから、誤魔化せると―――
rows.en: She was blinded by love. I thought I could fool her—

ghs.en: Because she is blind to love, and so it could trick her---

rows.en: Did I misread her that badly?

ghs.en: Was this so obvious that it could be predicted?

rows.jp: いや……断定できる要素は何もない。
rows.en: No... There is nothing conclusive yet.

Taichi: "Calm down."

rows.jp: とにかく、外に出てみよう。

ghs.en: Regardless, let's try going outside.

rows.jp: そこに、曜子ちゃんが待っていた。

ghs.en: And there, Youko-chan was waiting,
Taichi: "...?!"
smiling.

Taichi: "Eh?"

Youko: "It's just the two of us, Taichi."
I want to run away.

rows.en: My heart speeds up, and clear thought slips away.

rows.jp: プレッシャー、というやつだ。
rows.en: This is what people call pressure.

Taichi: "...and it... makes you that happy?"

rows.jp: 意識を保たないと、声が途切れる。

Taichi: "So you have..."

Youko: "Then, we will continue later."

Taichi: "Yeah, see you... later..."

rows.en: I have to lower her guard.

ghs.en: I was put off guard.
If this continues, I will stay off guard.
What method can I even use,
against her---
Taichi: "Ah..."

rows.en: Somehow, she’s left me holding a paper-wrapped sandwich against my chest.

Taichi: "I came to school, but..."
I scratch my head.

rows.jp: でも……ちょっと見ていこうかな。
rows.en: Still... maybe I’ll take a quick look around.

ghs.en: But... I'll just look around a bit.

rows.jp: 空気が薄くなったような、寂しさ。

ghs.en: Loneliness that made the air seem thinner.

rows.jp: 長くいられる自信がない。
rows.en: I’m not sure I can stay here long.

ghs.en: I don't have the confidence to stay here for long.
I left the classroom.

rows.en: It’s bigger than the classroom, and all the emptier for it.

ghs.en: A space bigger than the classroom's, a desolation greater than the classroom's.

ghs.en: I sit on the chair I always use.
Taichi: "Whew."

rows.jp: 一息ついたものの、やることは何もない。
rows.en: I take a breather, but there’s nothing to do.

ghs.en: I take a breather, despite there being nothing for me to do.

rows.en: There is no power, and no way to contact anyone else.

rows.en: “I need to start taking life a little slower.”

rows.jp: でも人って、気が急くものだ。
rows.en: But we’re always in a hurry.

...what a problem.
Taichi: "Nah, before I do that,"

rows.jp: 先輩とももう会えない。

rows.en: She’s gone back, taking with her any chance of ever tending to it.

rows.en: There are dangerous places in the fence.

ghs.en: There is a dangerous spot on the fence.

rows.en: The worlds overlapped before they could be repaired.

ghs.en: Worlds overlapped with it still unfixed.

rows.en: However often it is patched, this one section stays damp and weakens.

ghs.en: However many times it's mended, this one section gets wet, and weakens.

rows.en: The roof is part of the school, and somehow not.

rows.en: Here on the boundary with the sky, it feels like another world.

ghs.en: Here, in this boundary with the sky, it's like a different world.

Taichi: "...hm?"

Taichi: "Ninjas?"
Taichi: "'Cause there's any!"

rows.en: I smack the side of my head.

ghs.en: I strike the side of my head.

rows.jp: 脳天気成分がまだちょっと残っていたらしい。
rows.en: Apparently there’s still a trace of airhead in my system.

ghs.en: Seems I still have a bit of leftover optimism mixed in.
Taichi: "A mountain forest fire?"

Why a smoke signal?"

rows.en: I’ve barely finished thinking about taking life slower, and here I am sprinting.

ghs.en: But ain't this right next to the hokora?

rows.jp: 祠のそばで、彼女がすることといったら？
rows.en: What would she be doing beside the shrine?

ghs.en: What could she be possibly doing right next to the hokora?

ghs.en: A crackling sound out from the other side of the thicket.
I wade through, pushing my way forwards.
Taichi: "Ah..."

rows.en: Every last record dances with the flames.

ghs.en: All of them, the records, frolicking in the fire.

ghs.en: Rationality enters a freeze, but the body shivered on its own.

Taichi: "Burning them you say..."

rows.en: Is she allowed to burn those?

Taichi: "Burning those... isn't right."

rows.en: I say it in a voice absurdly calm for an emergency.

Taichi: "Say now..."

I swallow down saliva, and shout:

rows.en: She turns slowly to face me.

ghs.en: Youko: "Taichi's understanding is now something unnecessary."

ghs.en: Me, knowing about this cyclical world, unnecessary?

rows.en: “Idiot! Of course I do! Put it out!”

rows.en: I pick up a branch and move to break apart the burning heap.

Taichi: "Ngh... why..."
Youko: "Don't."

rows.en: “It’s burning all the way through. You could get hurt...”

ghs.en: Youko: "They are burning to the core now. It's dangerous..."

rows.jp: のろしを見てから、結構時間が経っている。
rows.en: It’s been a while since I saw the smoke.

ghs.en: A good amount of time has passed since I first saw the smoke signal.

rows.en: “This is insane. If you do this...”

rows.en: I have managed well enough lately.

ghs.en: I've been doing pretty well with myself recently, definitely,

rows.en: But there is no guarantee I will not die.

ghs.en: but I have no certainty I won't die.

rows.en: Illness. Accident... a sudden loss of control.

ghs.en: Illness, accidents... unexpectedly going rampant.

rows.en: Even if I died, the records would let me understand my position.

ghs.en: As long as the documents exist, I can understand my position even if I were to die.

rows.en: That insurance against catastrophe is turning to ash.

ghs.en: The insurance against that thousand-to-one event has now become ash.

rows.en: I drop the branch. She has twisted my wrist.

ghs.en: I drop the wooden stick. Because my wrist was being twisted.

rows.en: “I am the only one who needs to know.”

Taichi: "Youko-chan..."

what her scheme was.
Taichi: "...my... thoughts... you've..."

Taichi: "......"

The myself of now,

rows.en: The will to live through a life uniquely my own has no place in her purpose.

rows.en: But not the me who exists now.

rows.en: “Yes. I don’t want to keep secrets from you.”

rows.en: “Even if the person I am now gets reset, I might figure out the secret on my own someday.”

rows.en: “Without any information, there’s little chance you’ll discover the shrine’s system on your own.”

rows.en: She embraces me and peers into my eyes.
